scope: Worldwide top-down region→area→province source-role research matrix. All six continents and all 66 regions are assessed and all 489 areas/5,220 provinces inventoried. This is substantive sourced diagnostic coverage, not closure of every lower-tier geometry and granularity defect. All unresolved decisions stay visible.
rubric: Actual named administrative, functional, settlement or physical role, not ADM number
Whole named source parent versus fragmented border remnant
Functional urban core versus broad administrative municipality or region
Source canonical role, represented vintage, license and completeness
Disconnected territories, enclaves, islands and source omissions
Relative scale and neighbouring purpose, with sparse-rural exceptions
Weak parent matching and arbitrary nearest-centroid fallback
Preserve identities, original geometry and supported dated attributes during migration

regions.name: East Tropical Africa
regions.assessment: Inspected all 3 current areas, 209 provinces and 581 location records for roles/vintage/licenses, parent matches, repeated tiers and pixel omissions. Sources offer documented follow-up leads and selected role checks; no entire branch semantic approval is claimed.

Pin actual source boundary versions/licenses and retain provenance for all changes; no source-reference revision invents a historical date.

actionable_proposals: Check every botanical-country area against municipal/district/regional source roles and vintage; national statistical pages offer censuses but do not by themselves validate geometry.
Prioritize Nigeria/Ghana multi-province grouping purpose and coastal/island omissions, retaining administrative rural territory rather than only urban municipality coverage.
unresolved_work: Research and approve physical/administrative purpose for each flagged unit; source assessment does not close every boundary.
Validate original source geometry versus retained land coastlines, island coverage, settlement unions and neighboring units with independently licensed sources.
Pin actual source boundary versions/licenses and retain provenance for all changes; no source-reference revision invents a historical date.

regions.name: West-Central Tropical Africa
regions.assessment: Inspected all 10 current areas, 215 provinces and 1000 location records for roles/vintage/licenses, parent matches, repeated tiers and pixel omissions. Sources offer documented follow-up leads and selected role checks; no entire branch semantic approval is claimed.

regions.name: Arabian Peninsula
regions.assessment: The branch mixes Saudi governorates, Omani wilayat, Yemeni districts, Qatari municipalities, Kuwaiti governorates and UAE emirate/physical adaptations. These are different functions and vintages. Gulf States is a multi-state geographic area, while small emirates and Qatar are often coextensive province/location units. Mainland Arabian membership and Socotra continental convention must be assessed geographically, independently of owner.

National and disputed administrative claims must be separated from physical group membership.

regions.name: Indian Subcontinent
regions.assessment: This branch contains both finer Indian subdistrict locations grouped in district provinces/state areas and hundreds of retained district locations grouped in state provinces/botanical areas. That is an explicit mixed-tier system, not uniformly reviewed granularity. Bangladesh and Sri Lanka remain district-based; Bhutan locations are named dzongkhag districts despite source metadata calling ADM 1 Dzongdeys. Nepal retains 75 older district units and unnamed Province 1/2 references. Maldives natural and administrative atolls differ.

regions.name: Indo-China
regions.assessment: This branch mixes Cambodian district/municipality/khan, Lao muang, Myanmar township/district, Thai amphoe/khet and Vietnamese older district systems. The current 63-era Vietnamese provincial references and split group fragments are not contemporary 2026 administrative facts after the 2025 reorganisation. Andaman/Nicobar island association is a physical convention rather than Indian ownership geography.

regions.name: Mongolia
regions.assessment: Current 339 local units correspond to the source pattern of 330 sums and nine Ulaanbaatar districts, under 21 aimag and capital parents. These are meaningful sparse-rural local jurisdictions, but Ulaanbaatar municipality includes separated Baganuur/Bagakhangai/Nalaikh and cannot simply be merged wholesale as one urban core. Country label and Mongolian Plateau physical extent are different concepts.

regions.name: Siberia
regions.assessment: Western/Eastern Siberian geographic areas roughly adapt published botanical regions but contain Urals, Northern and Far Eastern Russia source remnants. Federal subjects, raions, municipalities and derived physical local units are different roles; sparse far-north territories should not be split to meet a global area quota. National federal-district administration is not a physical regional boundary.

regions.name: Central Europe
regions.assessment: Administrative hierarchy can support Länder/government-district/local-district clusters, cantons, Czech/Slovak regions and Polish voivodeships. The current mixture of country-sized WGSRPD areas and selected German Länder is not a consistent area role. Basel-Stadt occurs in three distinct province groups under France, Baden-Württemberg and Germany; these are declared geographic portions, not three modern cantons.

regions.name: Central America

Provinces presently represent Belize districts, Guatemala/Honduras/El Salvador/Nicaragua departments, Costa Rica provinces and Panama provinces/comarcas, while border fragments create counts above their source unit counts. The Pacific-island area includes Clipperton as a geographic exception.

regions.name: Northern South America
regions.assessment: Venezuelan municipios and Surinamese ressorts are meaningful local references. Guyana source district units need exact purpose verification rather than assuming the 27 polygons are current NDCs. French Guiana currently has only three physical forest adaptations, whereas the actual French official commune API lists 22 named communes; this is a concrete source/granularity mismatch. Whole-country areas and source-border remnants need country-independent physical assessment.

regions.name: South Atlantic Islands
regions.assessment: Current Falkland and South Georgia reference territories are each one whole-archipelago location with coextensive province/area tiers. The Falklands span East/West main islands and many smaller islands; South Georgia and South Sandwich are separate archipelagos hundreds of kilometres apart. Administrative ownership alone does not justify treating each entire dispersed territory as one local unit or settlement.

regions.name: Western South America
regions.assessment: The branch mixes Colombian municipios, Ecuadorian cantons, Peruvian provinces and Bolivian province/physical adaptations. These serve different local purposes and do not provide comparable uniform county-level coverage. Whole Bolivia/Colombia/Peru areas are broad national references, while the Andean/Amazonian physical systems cross their borders. Táchira western geographic portion is an explicit source remainder, not evidence owner should determine region.
